_about: The ONLY facts about DTJ an article may state. Copied from .claude/skills/dtj-landing-variants/references/claims-and-proof.md (14 Oct 2026). A number in a draft that is not in an 'approved' fact below blocks the draft. 'needs_source' facts are listed so the gate can name them; they may not be used until DTJ gives their source.

facts.text: DTJ offers a free growth audit of a brand's ads, store and funnel, to see where sales are leaking.
If we don't see a clear opportunity, we'll tell you.
After the audit form, DTJ checks the details first, then the team gets in touch by call, WhatsApp or email.
DTJ looks at the whole journey, from ads and targeting to the website, product pages and checkout, to find where potential customers are lost, and fixes it.
DTJ makes different ad versions, from customer-style videos to product demos, and keeps testing to find what brings in more buyers, optimising for profitable growth rather than clicks.
DTJ builds and improves Shopify stores and product pages so more visitors have a reason to buy.
When people search for products a brand sells, the brand should show up without paying for every click.
DTJ improves how products show up on Amazon, how they are presented, and what shoppers see before they buy.
The Royal Dosa Paper: ₹5.28Cr in sales and 1.68L orders, from almost no sales when DTJ started in March 2025 (the brand's own Shopify sales report).
Pro Effex: ₹1.5L → ₹40.18L in sales and 3,071 orders (the brand's own Shopify sales report).
After DTJ rebuilt a Pro Effex product page, its conversion rate went from 1.4% to 2.8% with the same traffic.
Little Rituals: ₹46.7L → ₹1.92Cr in sales (the brand's own Shopify sales report).
Sindhoi Patola Arts: ₹52.7L → ₹2.78Cr in sales (the brand's own Shopify sales report).
Saatvi: ₹37.6L → ₹1.07Cr in sales (the brand's own Shopify sales report).
Zebein: ₹9L → ₹3.56Cr in sales (the brand's own Shopify sales report).
Dadu Fresh showed as the first organic Google result for "healthy juice".
